script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Workplace
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

TITLE: THE UPPER HAND

INT. UPPER HAND - DAY

A contemporary, spacious office filled with sleek desks, laptops, and modern art. The UPPER HAND logo, an image of a hand holding a pen, hangs on the wall.

JESSICA (30s, ambitious, focused, always perfectly dressed), a senior marketing executive, sits at her desk, meticulously going through emails. She pauses, her eyes scanning an email from her boss.

INT. UPPER HAND - BOSS'S OFFICE - DAY

DAVID (50s, charismatic, successful), the CEO of Upper Hand, sits at his desk, looking out the window. He clicks through a presentation on his computer.

DAVID
(to himself)
Jessica's been with us for years. She's competent, but she's never taken that next step.

INT. UPPER HAND - JESSICA'S DESK - DAY

Jessica reads her boss's email. Her face falls.

JESSICA
(whispering to herself)
Next step?

INT. UPPER HAND - KITCHENETTE - DAY

Jessica, ANNA (early 30s, ambitious, friendly, and talkative), and MIKE (late 20s, ambitious, shy, and tech-savvy) gather for lunch.

ANNA
Did you hear about the new project David is working on?

JESSICA
No, I haven't.

MIKE
It's top secret. But he's planning to make a big announcement next week.

Jessica looks pensive.

INT. UPPER HAND - JESSICA'S DESK - NIGHT

Jessica types away at her laptop, determined. She finds an article about a new marketing strategy.

INT. UPPER HAND - DAVID'S OFFICE - DAY

David is on the phone with a client. Jessica knocks gently on the door.

DAVID
(on phone)
Yes, we'll get that done. (to Jessica) Come in.

Jessica enters. She presents her idea.

DAVID
(impressed)
This is exactly what I was looking for.

INT. UPPER HAND - KITCHENETTE - DAY

Anna and Mike discuss the new project, unsure of their roles.

ANNA
Have you heard anything about the new project?

MIKE
No. I've been working on my usual tasks.

INT. UPPER HAND - JESSICA'S DESK - DAY

Jessica receives an email confirmation of her new project. She smiles and claps her hands together.

INT. UPPER HAND - BOSS'S OFFICE - DAY

David makes his announcement to the team, and everyone is surprised, except for Jessica.

DAVID
And for this project, I've entrusted it to Jessica.

Anna and Mike exchange surprised glances.

INT. UPPER HAND - JESSICA'S DESK - NIGHT

Jessica works late, determined to make the project a success. She glances at her competitors' websites, taking notes.

INT. UPPER HAND - KITCHENETTE - DAY

Anna and Mike commiserate over their lack of progress.

ANNA
(frustrated)
Why didn't David trust us with this project?

MIKE
(thoughtful)
Maybe because he knows we'll be content with our current roles. Jessica, on the other hand, has always shown ambition.

INT. UPPER HAND - JESSICA'S DESK - DAY

Jessica's phone rings. It's her boss, congratulating her on her success.

DAVID
(on phone)
Jessica, you've outdone yourself.

Jessica smiles, her ambition validated.

THE END.
